experiments.name: Hook Format Impact on LinkedIn Engagement
experiments.hypothesis: if we lead with curiosity-based hooks instead of direct value statements, then click-through and engagement rates will increase by 25%+
experiments.control: linkedin_post with direct benefit opening (e.g., 'Here are 3 ways to...')
experiments.variant: linkedin_hooks format with pattern interrupts (e.g., 'Most lawyers get this wrong...')
experiments.metric: engagement rate, click-through rate, profile visits

experiments.name: Short-Form Video vs Static Content Conversion
experiments.hypothesis: if we convert top-performing listicles and blog_keyword topics into short_video format, then lead magnet downloads will increase by 40%
experiments.control: linkedin_carousel and listicle_post formats promoting lead magnets
experiments.variant: short_video_script converted to video format with same promotional CTA
experiments.metric: lead magnet conversions, view completion rate, cost per lead

experiments.name: X Thread Depth vs Single Tweet Engagement
experiments.hypothesis: if we publish x_thread_optimized versions instead of x_single posts on same topics, then impressions and bookmarks will grow 35% due to algorithmic favor of threaded conversations
experiments.control: x_single posts with x_hooks and x_cta
experiments.variant: x_thread_optimized threads exploring same legal topic across 5-7 tweets
experiments.metric: impressions, retweets, bookmarks, replies, engagement rate

experiments.name: Before/After Case Studies vs Hot Takes for Authority
experiments.hypothesis: if we use before_after case study format instead of hot_take opinion pieces, then lead quality (qualified prospects) will increase by 30% and cost-per-consultation will decrease
experiments.control: hot_take content with stat_graphic and quote_cards supporting opinion
experiments.variant: before_after format showcasing actual client transformation with measurable outcomes
experiments.metric: lead quality score, consultation booking rate, cost per qualified lead

priority_experiment: Hook Format Impact on LinkedIn Engagement - Run first because: (1) requires minimal resource investment (format change only), (2) fastest iteration cycle (weekly results visible), (3) with 40 unpublished pieces, you can immediately test 20 with control/variant hooks, and (4) hooks directly impact the funnel top, informing all downstream content performance. Success here amplifies ROI on remaining 40 pieces.
